_comment: Purpose oracle (HICCUPPS - see docs/ORACLES.md). CLAUDE.md puts SEO, responsiveness and accessibility on the same footing as tests, but until this existed only axe measured any of it. Mobile preset, because that is who plays this.

ci._assert_comment: Set from 9 measured runs across 3 URLs on 2026-08-22 (perf 100, a11y 100, seo 100, best-practices 96), not from ambition. accessibility and seo are deterministic here, so they sit at the measured value. best-practices is capped at 96 by a known console warning: 'frame-ancestors' is ignored in a <meta> CSP and only takes effect as an HTTP header, which netlify.toml and nginx.conf do send. performance stays a warning until there are a couple of weeks of runner data - it is the one score that moves with CI load. Ratchet up, never down.
